visualReview.notes: Inspected 54 current frames: 12 portable, 12 shared-material/flat-map and 30 Earth-rig/native-terrain/tier frames. Two open granite gateways, broad paired blue suspension bands passing through upper arched chambers, vertical hangers, open under-deck trusses, continuous road/tram deck, pedestrian rails and backstays remain coherent. Main gateway arches are open at every tier; nearer tiers retain the small upper band chambers. Five existing 256px shared graphs supply granite, coated steel, polished rail metal, paving aggregate and concrete; no private or embedded images. Exact-QID map outline and retained PMTiles road/two tram centerlines establish the signed orientation and tracks. The suspended roadway is 112.5m, distinct from the 126.6m portal-axis spacing and authored 176m approach length. All 30 Earth frames render the unmodified standard-viewer native terrain plus an explicitly schematic water fixture. End attachments use coarse ground+0.22m and foundations embed into the bank relief. Four focused tests prove source/tier bytes, open gateways and upper chambers, native end fit and actual runtime duplicate road/tram removal while preserving the transverse bank street. Minor High-shadow aliasing on shallow masonry relief and light stylized granite remain visible. Exact historic lettering/heraldry, original stone/steel connection dimensions, quay walls, surveyed grades, water levels and physical-device timing remain outside scope.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and four ordinary global Terrarium tiles; no bespoke terrain acquisition.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: The native field is unmodified. Its 5m sample grid oversamples a coarse mixed-source DEM. Endpoint heights follow ground+0.22m and portal foundations embed into this field. A rectangular water fixture represents the mapped wet crossing interval, not an exact bank polygon, and is excluded from the landmark GLB. Actual production road suppression was tested with retained road/tram coordinates and the crossing bank street.

sourceInventoryBinding.reason: The generator terrain inventory now declares all four existing grid input tiles instead of only the sparse-sampling tile. This changes wrapper recipe text and the model input key. All six GLBs, the actual rendered native grid/heightmap/descriptor, material graphs and all 54 actually inspected image bytes are unchanged. No new render or new visual review is claimed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers, at most six draws, no embedded/private images and separate position/normal streams. Detailed master is preserved separately. No physical laptop/phone timing claim.
